shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger with three real outcomes by power: soft drops into the skill-shot hole (or falls back to try again), medium settles the ball behind the maintenance-man drop target to trap a mode start, and full strength sends it around the right loop into the rollovers and pops.

shots.name: Upper-Left Flipper
shots.notes: Tucked below the Scrambled Eggs ride and feeds its loop; the quietest flipper on the machine, but it keeps balls out of the right outlane.

shots.name: Upper-Right Flipper
shots.notes: Handles the busy top section — a choice of loops, a row of drop targets, and grouped and individual standups.

shots.name: Skill-Shot Hole
shots.notes: High up the shooter lane. A soft plunge either falls back to the plunger or drops in; you can try as many times as you like. A made shot routes internally down to the Info Scoop.

shots.name: Maintenance Man Drop Target
shots.notes: A dual-function target behind the right loop. An opto senses a ball arriving from the loop side without dropping the target; hit normally from the flipper side, it drops as usual.

shots.name: Info Scoop
shots.notes: Sits just above the lower-right flipper and hands out random awards — the only true sucker shot on the playfield. Also receives balls automatically from the skill-shot hole and can kick out unpredictably, usually onto the right flipper.

shots.name: Flying Ghost
shots.notes: The centre ramp. Three hits build this coaster's traffic light from red to green; drains here are one of the game's more common ball-loss sources.

shots.name: Chicago Loop
shots.notes: The left ramp, angled so it's genuinely hard to send a ball straight down the right outlane from here. Three hits build this coaster.

shots.name: Flying Turns
shots.notes: The right ramp. Three hits build this coaster; it's also the multiball start shot once two balls are locked, and the extra-ball collection point at 6x bonus.

shots.name: Lock Lane
shots.notes: Sits under a diverter near the lower-left flipper. Receives diverted balls from Flying Ghost and Chicago Loop once lock is lit, then relaunches them with its own kicker.

shots.name: Snack Booth Sinkhole
shots.notes: One of only two shots the lower-left flipper can reach. Builds Snack Booth value with every hit.

shots.name: E-A-T Standups
shots.notes: Three standups just below the Snack Booth sinkhole, easy to forget since only the lower-left flipper reaches them.

shots.name: Scrambled Eggs
shots.notes: A loop feeding a rotating table above the upper-left flipper. Scores Jackpots and turns up inside several attraction modes; a weak shot can dribble back out awkwardly, but it isn't a sucker shot.

shots.name: Right Loop
shots.notes: The destination of a full-strength plunge; continues on into the rollover lanes and pop bumpers.

shots.name: Rollover Lanes
shots.notes: Steps the bonus multiplier with every completion, up to 6x.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Feed back toward the rollover lanes on a full-strength plunge.

shots.name: Billboard Stop-n-Win Target
shots.notes: Freezes the LED billboard's changing numbers. Best hit with the billboard in your line of sight if you can manage it.

shots.name: Upper Standups
shots.notes: A mix of grouped and individual standups in the busy top section of the playfield.

shots.name: Upper Drop Bank
shots.notes: A row of drop targets alongside the upper standups, part of what makes the top of this playfield worth learning shot by shot.

goals.title: Skill Shot: Soft Plunge to the Hole
goals.summary: The gentlest of the shooter lane's outcomes: a soft plunge that either drops into the skill-shot hole or falls back for another try, with no penalty for missing.
goals.reward: A random award at the Info Scoop

steps.action: Plunge just hard enough to drop into the skill-shot hole
steps.detail: Miss and the ball simply falls back to the plunger for another attempt. A made shot routes down to the Info Scoop for a random award rather than a fixed score, so it isn't always your best-value opening shot.

goals.title: The Medium Plunge Trick
goals.summary: A plunge nobody signposts for you: send the ball at medium strength so it settles behind the maintenance-man drop target instead of knocking it down, and you're dropped straight into one of six named attractions.
instructions: From the plunger, send the ball at medium strength toward the drop target behind the right loop, nicknamed the maintenance man
An opto behind the target senses the ball without it actually dropping, as long as the ball arrives from the loop side
Landing there launches one of six attractions immediately: Super Dunk, Power Ride, Toss Your Cookies, Dancing Digits, Spin and Bump, or Dunk the Dummy
A full-strength plunge instead sails past the target and continues around the loop, so it's the medium touch that makes this work
Play through all six across the game to open the Park Tycoon wizard mode
goals.reward: Launches directly into one of six attractions; clearing all six opens Park Tycoon

goals.title: Lower-Left Flipper: Snack Booths & E-A-T
goals.summary: The quiet lower-left flipper only reaches two things worth naming: a sinkhole that builds Snack Booth value, and a trio of E-A-T standups just below it.
goals.reward: Points toward Snack Booths with every sinkhole hit

steps.action: Drop the ball into the sinkhole from the lower-left flipper
steps.detail: Builds Snack Booth value with every hit

steps.action: Clip the three standups on the way past
steps.detail: Sit just below the sinkhole and are easy to forget about entirely

goals.title: Build All Three Coasters, Then Multiball
goals.summary: Turn each ramp's traffic light from red to green with three hits apiece, lock two balls at whichever ramp lights, and launch at the right ramp for the game's best animation.
goals.reward: Jackpots and Super Jackpots at the lit ramps

steps.action: Shoot the centre ramp three times to build Flying Ghost
steps.detail: Each hit steps its traffic light a shade closer to green

steps.action: Shoot the left ramp three times to build Chicago Loop
Shoot the right ramp three times to build Flying Turns
With all three built, lock a ball at the centre or left ramp
steps.detail: Both ramps divert into the lock lane once lock is lit

steps.action: Lock the second ball the same way
With two balls locked, shoot the right ramp to start multiball
steps.detail: The best display animation in the game

steps.action: Chase jackpots at whichever ramp is lit
steps.detail: Keep an eye on the inserts — it's easy to lose track mid-multiball of which one is hot. Scoring stays modest even across several Super Jackpots

goals.title: Ramp Rhythm: Left, Centre, Left
goals.summary: Chicago Loop and Flying Ghost sit close enough together to build a real back-and-forth rhythm once you find it.
goals.reward: Steady ramp value with each completed exchange

steps.action: Shoot the left ramp
steps.detail: The opening shot of the rhythm

steps.action: Combo straight into the centre ramp
Back to the left ramp again
steps.detail: Keep the rhythm going as long as you can hold it

goals.title: Build the Bonus Multiplier
goals.summary: A full-power plunge sends the ball around the right loop into the rollovers, where each completion steps the bonus multiplier — six times over lights an extra ball at the right ramp.
goals.reward: Extra ball once the bonus multiplier reaches 6x

steps.action: Roll through the lanes to build the multiplier
steps.detail: A hard plunge around the right loop is one way in; the pop bumpers can also feed them

steps.action: With the multiplier at 6x, shoot the right ramp for the extra ball

goals.title: Stop-n-Win the Billboard
goals.summary: The Stop-n-Win target freezes the LED billboard's changing numbers — stop three of them and cash in whatever they add up to.

steps.action: Hit the target to stop the first number
steps.detail: The billboard keeps cycling until you catch it

steps.action: Hit it twice more to stop a second and third number
steps.detail: Each stopped number is worth that many points times 100K

goals.title: Wizard Mode: Park Tycoon
goals.summary: The payoff for playing the whole roster: clear all six attraction modes and Park Tycoon opens as the game's biggest scoring opportunity by a wide margin.
goals.reward: Over 5M without much effort — by far the biggest scoring mode in the game

steps.action: Play all six attraction modes at least once across the game
steps.detail: Each one starts by trapping a medium-strength plunge behind this target

goals.title: Ride the Scrambled Eggs
goals.summary: Tucked above the upper-left flipper, the Scrambled Eggs ride is a loop feeding a rotating table — worth Jackpots on its own and a recurring player inside several attraction modes.
goals.reward: Jackpots, plus appearances inside several attraction modes

steps.action: Shoot the loop up onto the rotating table
steps.detail: A weak shot can dribble back out awkwardly, but it isn't the sucker shot on this game

goals.title: Take the Info Scoop Gamble
goals.summary: The one true sucker shot on the playfield — a scoop above the lower-right flipper that hands out a random award along with a curt 'Watch it!' warning.

steps.action: Shoot into the Info Scoop
steps.detail: It also receives balls automatically from the skill-shot hole and can kick back out unpredictably — usually onto the right flipper, occasionally straight down the middle

goals.title: Strategy: Round-Robin the Ramps
goals.summary: Work all three ramps evenly before chasing anything else, and stay alert around the game's real drain sources — missed centre-ramp shots, weak Scrambled Eggs exits, and Info Scoop kickouts.

steps.action: Take the soft plunge if you want a look at a random award
steps.detail: Optional, and it routes to a random-award scoop rather than fixed points — not necessarily your best-value opening shot

steps.action: Work all three ramps round-robin
steps.detail: Three hits each builds every coaster toward lock without favoring one side

steps.action: Take Scrambled Eggs shots at full strength
steps.detail: A weak dribble-out is one of the game's few real drain risks

steps.action: Lock two and launch at the right ramp once all three are built
steps.detail: Then chase jackpots carefully — it's easy to lose track of which ramp is lit

achievements.title: First Drop
achievements.desc: Land the soft plunge in the skill-shot hole.

achievements.title: Secret Ride Ticket
achievements.desc: Trap a medium-strength plunge behind the maintenance man to launch straight into an attraction.

achievements.title: Rotating Table Regular
achievements.desc: Shoot the Scrambled Eggs loop up onto the rotating table.

achievements.title: Three Green Lights
achievements.desc: Build all three rollercoasters and lock two balls to start multiball.

achievements.title: Six-Times Bonus
achievements.desc: Build the bonus multiplier to 6x and collect the extra ball.

achievements.title: Billboard Stopped Cold
achievements.desc: Stop three numbers on the LED billboard in a single Stop-n-Win.

achievements.title: Full Rhythm
achievements.desc: Chain Chicago Loop and Flying Ghost back and forth to build a real ramp rhythm.

achievements.title: Grand Opening
achievements.desc: Clear all six attraction modes and reach Park Tycoon.
